title: WalletAnalysisRequest
description: Request body for OnFRA wallet financial reputation analysis on Celo.

walletAddress.description: EVM wallet address to analyze (Celo-first, multi-chain supported).

months.description: Months of transaction history for cash-flow statement (default 3).

includeAttestation.description: Include AI-generated attestation paragraph in the response.

oneOf.description: Comma-separated field keys to return instead of the full payload.

fields.description: Optional subset of analysis fields. Omit for full response. Signal reads from cache are free via GET /api/wallet/{address}/signals/{signal}.

force.description: Bypass cache and run a fresh analysis (charges x402 for external wallets).

callerAddress.description: Wallet paying via x402 when querying an external address.
